items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: Plus, Wes was really George's idol.

ctx.x: And he thought George was the logical inheritor?

Right, especially if Buddy and I were with him, to give the Montgomery relationship. Plus, Wes was really George's idol. There wasn't no razzmatazz behind it. And George will say it even today, that was his idol. I know for a fact the relationship between the two of them was deep. Respect; Wes had the greatest respect for George. He loved George.
Did you pick up on that? I don't...
